standing_rules.source: Spoken 2026-09-26. Re-checked against this machine on 2026-09-29. Model/Hermes/Claude/Grok lines corrected 2026-10-14 against openclaw.json, ~/.hermes/config.yaml and Max's sprint plan. Not a meter reading. Claude/Grok/ChatGPT lines updated 2026-10-23 when the live poll (frontier-usage-poll.py) replaced browser snapshots.
rules: Comfort band is 80–90% used. Crossing 80% is enough. 85–90 is fine. Do not grind the week to 100%.
Two failure modes were named: running out about three days early, or climbing the last two days from about 40% to 80%. That is the pattern to avoid. It is not today's percent.
A reply that dies at Sir is an output or context limit. It is not a quota hit.
SuperGrok Heavy annual is under consideration. It is not bought. Do not purchase from this board. Hold the stated October expiry until Adam says buy.

Plan names on the cards are labels, not receipts. ChatGPT tier is not confirmed here. Claude: the fleet runs on Adam's Claude Max account; its week/5-hour percentages on the card come live from the Anthropic usage API (weekly reset Wed ~15:00 ET).
Grok and ChatGPT percentages on the cards come live from the OAuth sign-ins OpenClaw already holds (`openclaw models status`). The Heavy meter is grok.com. console.x.ai is a different meter.
Scorecard refine and commerce enrichment are pointed at grok-4.7, not local Qwen. Pastor extract still points at local 1235, then 1234. Do not flatten those lanes.

Hermes on this machine defaults to Codex gpt-5.6-sol (fallbacks Claude Opus 5, grok-4.7, local Qwen). Max and nine desks run Claude Opus 5.5; Prof X, Rush, SgtMaj Mac and Nimble run grok-4.7. Fable is capped this week. Do not retune from this page.
A login wall, a bot check, or a block page is not remaining quota.

Pacing (Adam, 2026-10-23): Claude week should sit at 80–90% by Tuesday afternoon and about 90% by Wednesday noon, never dry on Monday morning. A meter near empty within 24h of its reset is the plan, not an alarm.
